name: Quick Apps
author: samara-hub-ro
description: A discreet launcher in the Omarchy bar: your most-used applications, grouped into your own colour-coded categories, opening on hover — counting every time you open them, from the panel or from anywhere else.

barWidget.description: Your most-used applications by category, one hover away from the bar. Colour-coded groups you can drag into order, a launch count on every tile, and a ranking of your busiest applications on top.

schema.label: Open on hover
schema.description: Show the panel when the pointer rests on the bar icon. With this off, the icon opens on click and the keybinding still works.

schema.label: Hover delay (ms)
schema.description: How long the pointer has to sit on the icon before the panel opens. Raise it if the panel appears while you are passing by.

schema.label: Close delay (ms)
schema.description: Grace period after the pointer leaves the icon and the panel, so crossing the gap between them does not close it.

schema.label: Background opacity (%)
schema.description: Opacity of the panel background. Lower is more see-through; pair it with a Hyprland blur layerrule for a frosted panel.

schema.label: Icon size (px)
schema.description: Size of each application icon in the grid.

schema.label: Columns
schema.description: How many applications sit side by side before the grid wraps. This is what sets the panel's width.

schema.label: Maximum height (px)
schema.description: How tall the scrolling grid is allowed to grow before it starts scrolling inside the panel. The most-used strip sits above it and is not charged against this.

schema.label: Show application names
schema.description: Print each application's name under its icon. Turn it off for a tighter, icon-only grid.

schema.label: Show most used
schema.description: Put a ranking of your busiest applications at the top of the panel, above the categories. It is hidden while you are editing or filtering.

schema.label: Most used entries
schema.description: How many applications the ranking lists — and how many orbits the chart beside it draws.

schema.label: Show the usage chart
schema.description: Draw the orbit chart beside the ranking: one arc per application, longest for the one you open most.

schema.label: Show launch counts
schema.description: Print a small badge on each tile with the number of times that application has been opened from the launcher since you added it to a category.

schema.label: Count launches from elsewhere
schema.description: Also count an application when it is opened from a keybinding, the Omarchy menu, a terminal or anything else, by watching for its window. Turn this off to count only what you launch from this panel.

schema.label: Sort tiles by launch count
schema.description: Order the tiles inside each category most-launched first, instead of the order you arranged them in. Applications you have never opened keep their stored order, and turning this off puts everything straight back — the sort never rewrites your file.

schema.label: Counter glyph
schema.description: Glyph shown next to a launch count. Any character your bar font carries.

schema.label: Category tint (%)
schema.description: How strongly each category's colour washes its background. The default of 30 is 70% transparent — enough to group the tiles under it, far too faint to fight the icons. 0 turns the tint off.

schema.label: Fill categories on first use
schema.description: The first time the panel opens with nothing in it, build a starting set of categories from the applications you have installed.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Glyph shown in the bar. Leave it empty for the drawn mark — a downward triangle with an S cut out of it — or put any character your bar font carries here to replace it.

schema.label: Categories file
schema.description: Where the categories and their applications are stored. Defaults to ~/.config/omarchy/quick-apps.json.
